import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04bRootGermCollar
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N03FixedRootOrdinaryJets

/-!
# Identifying the chosen controlled root model for each actual state

The real N03 coefficient germs and angular periodicity give one collar
for a fixed state. That collar is used only to identify the same previously
chosen controlled flow and its chart near the root. Its width enters no
jet bound. No fixed correction cutoff or uniform collar over states is
assumed, and the original reference, correction and stored atlas remain.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff Topology

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

private theorem stateRoot_storedFlow_of_coefficient_band
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hL : N03Properties D T S C E L base ε)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (rightEnd : Bool)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) {R δ ρ : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hρw : ρ < C.right m - C.left m) (hρR : ρ ≤ R / 4)
    (hstrip : RootCoefficientStripConditions D.w g (stateProfile D S C z.1)
      (stateHeight D S C z) (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
      (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ρ, ∀ θ : ℝ,
      let p : PolarPoint := (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd +
        n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd * t, θ)
      (L.coefficients z).a p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
        (L.coefficients z).b p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ∧
        (L.coefficients z).c p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p)
    {Θ : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hΘ : N04FlowEquations
      (rootRescaledField
        (localizedRootDrift D S C (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
          (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) hR z)
        (localizedRootSpeed D S C g (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
          (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) hR z) δ) Θ) :
    RootStoredFlowAgreementOn C L z m rightEnd δ (ρ / δ) Θ := by
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd
  let σ := n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd
  let η := ρ / δ
  have hη : 0 < η := div_pos hρ hδ
  have hscale : δ * η = ρ := by dsimp [η]; field_simp [hδ.ne']
  have hregular := contDiff_localizedRootFields_of_n01 hS hT hN hg hR hstrip
  have hperiod := periodic_localizedRootFields hS C g r σ hR z
  intro ι x hx
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => L.minusFlow z m (r + σ * t) ι
  have hstored := hL.2.2.2.2.1 z hz hs m ι
  have hmap : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => r + σ * t)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) ρ) (Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) := by
    intro t ht
    have htwidth : t < C.right m - C.left m := ht.2.trans_lt hρw
    cases rightEnd <;>
      simp only [r, σ, n01ComponentRoot, n01ComponentRootOrientation,
        Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, one_mul, neg_one_mul] <;>
      constructor <;> linarith only [ht.1, htwidth]
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc (0 : ℝ) ρ) :=
    hstored.2.1.comp (continuous_const.add
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn hmap
  have hode : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ,
      HasDerivAt f (rootPhysicalSpeed (localizedRootDrift D S C r σ hR z)
        (localizedRootSpeed D S C g r σ hR z) (-σ) (t, f t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have htwidth : t < C.right m - C.left m := ht.2.trans hρw
    have hp : r + σ * t ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) := by
      cases rightEnd <;>
        simp only [r, σ, n01ComponentRoot, n01ComponentRootOrientation,
          Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, one_mul, neg_one_mul] <;>
        constructor <;> linarith only [ht.1, htwidth]
    have hv :
        (L.coefficients z).a (r + σ * t, f t) =
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).a (r + σ * t, f t) ∧
          (L.coefficients z).b (r + σ * t, f t) =
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).b (r + σ * t, f t) ∧
          (L.coefficients z).c (r + σ * t, f t) =
            (originalCoefficients D S C z).c (r + σ * t, f t) :=
      hcoeff t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht) (f t)
    have heq : minusCharacteristicSpeed (L.coefficients z) (r + σ * t, f t) =
        minusCharacteristicSpeed (originalCoefficients D S C z) (r + σ * t, f t) := by
      simp only [minusCharacteristicSpeed, hv.1, hv.2.1, hv.2.2]
    have hraw := rootPhysicalSpeed_localization_eq_oriented_polarMinus
      (contDiff_stateProfile_of_n01 hS hT hN z.1)
      (contDiff_stateHeight_of_n01 hS hT hN z) hR hstrip
      (p := (t, f t)) ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le.trans hρR⟩
    have hraw' : rootPhysicalSpeed (localizedRootDrift D S C r σ hR z)
        (localizedRootSpeed D S C g r σ hR z) (-σ) (t, f t) =
        σ * minusCharacteristicSpeed (originalCoefficients D S C z) (r + σ * t, f t) :=
      hraw
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => r + σ * s) σ t := by
      simpa only [mul_one, id_eq] using ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul σ).const_add r
    have hd := (hstored.2.2.1 (r + σ * t) hp).comp t hlin
    have hf : (fun u => L.minusFlow z m u ι) ∘ (fun s : ℝ => r + σ * s) = f := by
      funext s
      exact Function.comp_apply
    rw [hf] at hd
    change HasDerivAt f
      (minusCharacteristicSpeed (L.coefficients z) (r + σ * t, f t) * σ) t at hd
    apply hd.congr_deriv
    rw [hraw', heq]
    ring
  have hinit : f 0 = L.minusFlow z m r ι := by simp only [f, mul_zero, add_zero]
  exact rootRescaledFlow_eq_storedTrajectory (f := f) hη hδ Real.pi_ne_zero
    hregular.1 hregular.2 hperiod.1 hperiod.2 hΘ hinit
    (by simpa only [hscale] using hcont)
    (fun t ht => hode t (by simpa only [hscale] using ht)) hx

private theorem stateRoot_chart_of_glued_values
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData} {C : NonlinearGeometryData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (rightEnd : Bool)
    {G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {p q : PolarPoint} (hq : 0 < q.1)
    (hp : p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z
      (if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1))
    (ht : canonicalGluedRootTravel S K z m rightEnd p =
      q.1 ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * rootOddCoefficient G q)
    (ha : (canonicalGluedAiryIntegral S K z m 1 p +
      canonicalGluedAiryIntegral S K z m (-1) p) / 2 = rootEven G q) :
    K.chart z (if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1) p =
      extendedRootEvenOddChart G q := by
  let i := if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  have hvalues := canonicalCutPair_chartValues_of_gluedIntegrals
    m rightEnd (hB.1.2 z hz hs m).2.2.1 hp
  have htravel : airyTravelPrimitive (K.chart z i p).1 =
      q.1 ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * rootOddCoefficient G q := hvalues.2.trans ht
  have hangle : (K.chart z i p).2 = rootEven G q := hvalues.1.trans ha
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hl, hr, _, _⟩ := hB.1.1 m
  have hzero : K.left i = 0 := by cases rightEnd <;> assumption
  have hcanonical := (hA.charts z hz hs i).1 hp
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (K.chart z i p).1 := by
    have hb : K.left i < (K.chart z i p).1 := hcanonical.1.1
    exact (hzero ▸ hb).le
  apply (extendedRootEvenOddChart_eq_of_travel_values hq hnonneg ?_).symm
  exact (characteristicTravelChart_rootCharacteristicCoordinate G hq).trans
    (Prod.ext htravel.symm hangle.symm)

/-- The actual stored chart agrees with the supplied controlled model on
some state-dependent band. The original scale and flow remain unchanged.
This is an identification result, not a quantitative lower bound for the
state-dependent identification radius. -/
theorem n03_exists_state_controlledRoot_band
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (rightEnd : Bool)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) {R δ M : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hstrip : RootCoefficientStripConditions D.w g (stateProfile D S C z.1)
      (stateHeight D S C z) (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
      (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) R)
    (Θ : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hΘ : N04FlowEquations
      (rootRescaledField
        (localizedRootDrift D S C (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
          (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) hR z)
        (localizedRootSpeed D S C g (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
          (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) hR z) δ) Θ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)))
    (hperiod : ∀ x ζ θ,
      rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)
          (x, ζ, θ + Real.pi) =
        rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)
          (x, ζ, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hCS : CSBound 1
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi)
      (rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)) M) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 ∧ δ * ρ ≤ R / 4 ∧
      ControlledRootBandChartAgreement C K z m rightEnd δ ρ Θ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) ρ, ∀ θ : ℝ,
        let p : PolarPoint := (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd +
          n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd * (δ * x), θ)
        (L.coefficients z).a p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
          (L.coefficients z).b p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ∧
          (L.coefficients z).c p = (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p := by
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd
  let σ := n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd
  let G := rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)
  have hroot := n01_component_root_data hN.1.1 m rightEnd
  have hw : 0 < C.right m - C.left m := sub_pos.mpr (hN.1.1.2.2.2.1.1 m).2.1
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hcoeffRoot⟩ :=
    n04b_through03_root_coefficient_collar hS hN hfield hz hs hroot.1 hroot.2.1
  let a := min (δ / 2) (min ((C.right m - C.left m) / 2) (min (R / 4) (ε₀ / 2)))
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_min (half_pos hδ)
    (lt_min (half_pos hw) (lt_min (div_pos hR (by norm_num)) (half_pos hε₀)))
  have haδ : a < δ := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (half_lt_self hδ)
  have haw : a < C.right m - C.left m :=
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hw)
  have haR : a ≤ R / 4 :=
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have haε : a < ε₀ :=
    (((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans_lt
      (half_lt_self hε₀)
  have hcoeff (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a) (θ : ℝ) :
      (L.coefficients z).a (r + σ * t, θ) = (originalCoefficients D S C z).a (r + σ * t, θ) ∧
        (L.coefficients z).b (r + σ * t, θ) = (originalCoefficients D S C z).b (r + σ * t, θ) ∧
        (L.coefficients z).c (r + σ * t, θ) = (originalCoefficients D S C z).c (r + σ * t, θ) := by
    have habs : |r + σ * t - r| = t := by
      rcases n01ComponentRootOrientation_eq rightEnd with h | h
      · rw [show σ = 1 from h]
        simpa only [one_mul, add_sub_cancel_left] using abs_of_nonneg ht.1
      · rw [show σ = -1 from h]
        simpa only [neg_one_mul, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg] using abs_of_nonneg ht.1
    exact (hcoeffRoot (r + σ * t) θ (by
      change |r + σ * t - r| < ε₀
      rw [habs]
      exact ht.2.trans_lt haε)).2
  let η := a / δ
  have hη : 0 < η := div_pos ha hδ
  have hηone : η ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mpr (by simpa only [one_mul] using haδ.le)
  have hscale : δ * η = a := by dsimp only [η]; field_simp [hδ.ne']
  have hmatch : RootStoredFlowAgreementOn C L z m rightEnd δ η Θ :=
    stateRoot_storedFlow_of_coefficient_band hS hT hN.1.1 hN.2 hz hs m rightEnd
      hg hR hδ ha haw haR hstrip hcoeff hΘ
  have hcut : 0 < K.cutRadius m := (hB.1.1 m).2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hcutTravel : 0 < airyTravelPrimitive (K.cutRadius m) :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2 / 3) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hcut _)
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρη, hsmall⟩ :=
    exists_rootTravel_uniform_small_band hη hηone hcutTravel hM
  have hρR : δ * ρ ≤ R / 4 := by
    calc
      δ * ρ ≤ δ * η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρη hδ.le
      _ = a := hscale
      _ ≤ R / 4 := haR
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hρη.trans hηone, hρR, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [ControlledRootBandChartAgreement]
    intro x hx θ
    have hdx : 0 < δ * x := mul_pos hδ hx.1
    have hdxwidth : δ * x < C.right m - C.left m := by
      calc
        δ * x ≤ δ * η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx.2.trans hρη) hδ.le
        _ = a := hscale
        _ < C.right m - C.left m := haw
    have hphysical : r + σ * (δ * x) ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) := by
      cases rightEnd <;>
        simp only [r, σ, n01ComponentRoot, n01ComponentRootOrientation,
          Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, one_mul, neg_one_mul, Set.mem_Ioo] <;>
        constructor <;> linarith only [hdx, hdxwidth]
    have hvalues := n03_rootTravel_eq_controlledRootTravel_on_band
      hS hT hN.1.1 hN.1.2 hN.2 hA hB hz hs m rightEnd hg hR hstrip hΘ
      hmatch ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hρη⟩ hphysical θ
    have htravel := hsmall G hG hperiod hCS x ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩ θ
    have hown := canonicalCutPair_mem_own_half_of_rootTravel_lt hA hB hz hs m rightEnd
      ⟨hphysical, mem_univ θ⟩ (hvalues.1.trans_lt htravel)
    exact ⟨hown, stateRoot_chart_of_glued_values hA hB hz hs m rightEnd
      hx.1 hown hvalues.1 hvalues.2⟩
  · intro x hx θ
    have ht : δ * x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a := by
      refine ⟨(mul_pos hδ hx.1).le, ?_⟩
      calc
        δ * x ≤ δ * η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx.2.trans hρη) hδ.le
        _ = a := hscale
    exact hcoeff (δ * x) ht θ

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N03StateRootBandIdentification
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N01ControlledRootModel
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.RootPhysicalJetTransfer
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04FlowJetsProof

/-!
# Uniform ordinary jets at the actual stored root circles

The same controlled N01 model has uniform bounds before the state is
chosen. Actual N03 coefficient germs identify that model with the stored
chart and height on a band which may depend on the state. Only the root
point is used below, so the identification radius does not enter any
constant. No fixed-cutoff representation of the correction is required.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def N03RootEndpointFieldFamily
    (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (rightEnd : Bool)
    (κJ : ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd
  let i := if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 → ∀ θ : ℝ,
    (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K z i ∧
      κJ ≤ |planeJacobian (K.chart z i) (r, θ)| ∧
      RootPhysicalFieldJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        loss B (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart z i) (K.height z i) (r, θ)

private theorem n03_rootEndpoint_fields_at_state
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss flowLoss outLoss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (rightEnd : Bool)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    {R δ ρ Λ J₀ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    {A B : ℕ → ℝ} (hApos : ∀ n, 0 < A n) (hBpos : ∀ n, 0 < B n)
    (hstrip : RootCoefficientStripConditions D.w g (stateProfile D S C z.1)
      (stateHeight D S C z) (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
      (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) R)
    (hmodel : N01ControlledRootModelAtState D S C m rightEnd g hR δ ρ Λ J₀
      flowLoss outLoss A B z) :
    let r := n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd
    let σ := n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd
    let i := if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
    ∀ θ : ℝ, (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K z i ∧
      J₀ / δ ≤ |planeJacobian (K.chart z i) (r, θ)| ∧
      RootPhysicalFieldJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        outLoss (rootAffineJetEnvelope (σ * δ) B) (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
        (K.chart z i) (K.height z i) (r, θ) := by
  obtain ⟨_hcontrol, Θ, hΘ, hG, hperiod, hCS, hvalues, hjets⟩ := hmodel
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd
  let σ := n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd
  let i := if rightEnd then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let G := rootScaledInverseCoordinate Θ (n01RootLabel S C z m rightEnd) (Real.sqrt δ)
  let V := rootScaledDividedDiscriminant D S C z g r σ δ
  let M := A 1 * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (1 + flowLoss)
    (z - (C.referenceState, 0)))
  have hM : 0 ≤ M :=
    mul_nonneg (hApos 1).le (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, _hηone, hηR, hband, hcoeff⟩ :=
    n03_exists_state_controlledRoot_band hS hT hN hfield hA hB hz hs m rightEnd
      hg hR hδ hM hstrip Θ hΘ hG hperiod (hCS 1)
  have hσne : σ ≠ 0 := by
    rcases n01ComponentRootOrientation_eq rightEnd with h | h <;>
      rw [show σ = _ from h] <;> norm_num
  have hscaleNe : σ * δ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hσne hδ.ne'
  have hscaleAbs : |σ * δ| = δ := by
    rcases n01ComponentRootOrientation_eq rightEnd with h | h
    · rw [show σ = 1 from h]
      simp only [one_mul, abs_of_pos hδ]
    · rw [show σ = -1 from h]
      simp only [neg_one_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hδ]
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ρ := ⟨le_rfl, hρ.le⟩
  have hmodelRoot : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      RootPhysicalFieldJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        outLoss B (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
        (extendedRootEvenOddChart G) (rootDividedHeight δ V G) (0, θ) :=
    rootDividedModel_jetBound_allAngles hδ hG hperiod
      (rootScaledDividedDiscriminant_period_add hS C z g r σ δ)
      (fun θ => ⟨(hvalues (0, θ) hzero).1, (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).2.1,
        (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).2.2.1⟩)
      (fun θ hθ => hjets (0, θ) hzero hθ)
  intro θ
  have hclosed : (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K z i := by
    simpa only [r, i, n01ComponentRoot] using
      (canonicalCutPair_root_mem_closed_and_zero hA hB hz hs m rightEnd θ).1
  have hregular := (hA.boundary z hz hs i).2.2.2.2.1 (r, θ) hclosed
  have hident := n03_fixedRoot_chart_height_ordinaryJets hS hT hN.1.1 hN.2 hA hB
    hz hs m rightEnd hR hδ hη hηR hstrip Θ hband hcoeff hG hperiod
    (q := (0, θ)) ⟨le_rfl, hη.le⟩
    (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).1 (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).2.1
    (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).2.2.1
  have hpoint : rootProfileShift r (σ * δ) (0, θ) = (r, θ) := by
    simp only [rootProfileShift, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hFjet (n : ℕ) :
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => K.chart z i (rootProfileShift r (σ * δ) y)) (0, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (extendedRootEvenOddChart G) (0, θ) := by
    simpa only [rootProfileShift, mul_assoc] using hident.2.2.1 n
  have hHjet (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => K.height z i (rootProfileShift r (σ * δ) y) ^ a) (0, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => rootDividedHeight δ V G y ^ a) (0, θ) := by
    simpa only [rootProfileShift, mul_assoc] using hident.2.2.2 a n
  have htransfer := rootPhysicalFields_of_scaled_jet_model
    (E := AnnularState S × ℝ) (p := pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
    (loss := outLoss) (B := B) (z := z - (C.referenceState, 0))
    r (σ * δ) hscaleNe (fun n => (hBpos n).le)
    (F := K.chart z i) (M := extendedRootEvenOddChart G)
    (H := K.height z i) (h := rootDividedHeight δ V G) (q := (0, θ))
    (by simpa only [hpoint] using hregular.1)
    (by simpa only [hpoint] using hregular.2.1)
    (by simpa only [hpoint] using hregular.2.2.2)
    (hmodelRoot θ) hFjet hHjet (hvalues (0, θ) hzero).2.2.2
  exact ⟨hclosed, by simpa only [hpoint, hscaleAbs] using htransfer.2,
    by simpa only [hpoint] using htransfer.1⟩

/-- Common low order and loss are chosen before the component. For each
component and side, all actual root-field constants are chosen before
the state. Only endpoint jets are asserted: no state-uniform physical
collar is inferred from the original N03 germ statement. -/
theorem n03_controlledRoot_endpoint_physicalJets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε)
    (hflow : OrdinaryFlowJacobianBounds S C base ε) (flowLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ low outLoss : ℕ, outLoss ≤ low ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ rightEnd : Bool, ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ,
      ∀ R : ℝ, ∀ hR : 0 < R, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      (∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
        RootCoefficientStripConditions D.w g (stateProfile D S C z.1)
          (stateHeight D S C z) (n01ComponentRoot C m rightEnd)
          (n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd) R) →
      ∀ κ δ Λ : ℝ, 0 < κ → 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < A n) →
      N01ControlledRootInputFamily D S C base flowLoss ε m rightEnd g hR κ δ Λ A →
      ∃ κJ : ℝ, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, 0 < κJ ∧ (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
        N03RootEndpointFieldFamily S C K (max base low) outLoss
          (min ε (1 / 2 : ℝ)) m rightEnd κJ B := by
  obtain ⟨lowM, outLoss, hmodel⟩ :=
    n01_controlledRootInput_uniform_model hS hT hN.1.1 hflow flowLoss
  let low := max lowM outLoss
  refine ⟨low, outLoss, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro m rightEnd g R hR hg hstrip κ δ Λ hκ hδ hδone A hApos hinput
  obtain ⟨ρ, J₀, B, hρ, _hρone, _hρR, hJ₀, hBpos, hmodels⟩ :=
    hmodel m rightEnd g R hR hg hstrip κ δ Λ 1 hκ hδ hδone
      zero_lt_one le_rfl A hApos hinput
  let σ := n01ComponentRootOrientation rightEnd
  refine ⟨J₀ / δ, rootAffineJetEnvelope (σ * δ) B, div_pos hJ₀ hδ,
    rootAffineJetEnvelope_pos hBpos (σ * δ), ?_⟩
  dsimp only [N03RootEndpointFieldFamily]
  intro z hz hs
  have hzold : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _) hz
  have hzmodel : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C (max base lowM) (min ε (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C (max_le_max le_rfl (le_max_left _ _)) le_rfl hz
  exact n03_rootEndpoint_fields_at_state hS hT hN hfield hA hB hzold hs m rightEnd
    hg hR hδ hρ hApos hBpos (hstrip z hzold hs) (hmodels z hzmodel hs)

/-- The genuine N01 chosen-flow factory supplies every input of the
endpoint theorem on one smaller common neighborhood. All original
D/T/S/C/E/L/K data remain; the component constants precede every state. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_root_endpoint_fields
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ rightEnd : Bool,
        ∃ κJ : ℝ, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, 0 < κJ ∧ (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
          N03RootEndpointFieldFamily S C K newBase outLoss ε' m rightEnd κJ B := by
  obtain ⟨rootBase, flowLoss, η, hb, hη, hηε, hflow, hinputs⟩ :=
    n01_exists_common_root_inputs n04FlowJetsTarget_proof hS hT hN.1.1
  have hsub := stateNeighborhood_mono S C hb hηε
  have hN' := nonlinearPropertiesThrough03_restrict hT hN hb le_rfl hη hηε
  have hA' := n04PartA_restrict hA hb hηε
  have hB' := n04PartB_restrict hB hb hηε
  have hfield' : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L rootBase η :=
    { smooth_coefficients := fun z hz => hfield.smooth_coefficients z (hsub hz)
      periodic_coefficients := fun z hz => hfield.periodic_coefficients z (hsub hz)
      positive_a := fun z hz => hfield.positive_a z (hsub hz)
      negative_discriminant := fun z hz => hfield.negative_discriminant z (hsub hz) }
  obtain ⟨low, outLoss, hout, hbound⟩ :=
    n03_controlledRoot_endpoint_physicalJets hS hT hN' hfield' hA' hB' hflow flowLoss
  refine ⟨max rootBase low, outLoss, min η (1 / 2 : ℝ),
    hb.trans (le_max_left _ _), hout.trans (le_max_right _ _),
    lt_min hη (by norm_num), (min_le_left _ _).trans hηε, ?_⟩
  intro m rightEnd
  obtain ⟨g, R, hR, κ, hg, _hg0, hκ, _hfactor, hgeometry, hflows⟩ :=
    hinputs m rightEnd
  obtain ⟨δ, A, hδ, _hδR, hδone, hApos, hfamily⟩ := hflows 1 zero_lt_one
  exact hbound m rightEnd g R hR hg (fun z hz hs => (hgeometry.1 z hz hs).1)
    κ δ 1 hκ hδ hδone A hApos hfamily

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Fixed-loss bounds for actual relative root maps and height products

These pointwise calculus adapters keep the genuine inverse germs. They
introduce no bound on the zeroth-order angular lift. Every low order and
loss is selected before the numerical component envelopes and Jacobian
lower bound. Scalar values are handled by their actual zeroth-order jets.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

private theorem relativeRoot_bound_mono
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) {z : E}
    {n l L : ℕ} (hl : l ≤ L) {v A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hv : v ≤ A * (1 + p (n + l) z)) :
    v ≤ B * (1 + p (n + L) z) :=
  hv.trans (mul_le_mul hAB
    (add_le_add le_rfl (hp (Nat.add_le_add_left hl n) z))
    (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _)) (hA.trans hAB))

theorem coordinateComposition_positiveJets_fixed_loss
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {X Y Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (inputLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < A n) →
      ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
      ∀ z : E, p base z ≤ 1 → ∀ f : Y → Z, ∀ g : X → Y, ∀ x : X,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (g x) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (g x)‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f ∘ g) x‖ ≤
          B n * (1 + p (n + loss) z) := by
  obtain ⟨base, loss, hcomp⟩ :=
    coordinateComposition_fixed_loss_material_bound (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z)
      hp hI inputLoss
  refine ⟨base, loss, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbound⟩ := hcomp (fun n => 1 + A n)
    (fun n => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hA n).le)
  refine ⟨fun n => B (n - 1), fun n => hB (n - 1), ?_⟩
  intro z hz f g x hf hg hfj hgj n hn
  have hmajor {F : X → Y} {q : X} {k : ℕ}
      (h : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F q‖ ≤ A k * (1 + p (k + inputLoss) z)) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F q‖ ≤
        (1 + A k) * (1 : ℝ) ^ (1 + A k) * (1 + p (k + inputLoss) z) := by
    simpa only [Real.one_rpow, mul_one] using
      relativeRoot_bound_mono hp le_rfl (hA k).le
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one) h
  have houter (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f (g x)‖ ≤
        (1 + A k) * (1 : ℝ) ^ (1 + A k) * (1 + p (k + inputLoss) z) := by
    simpa only [Real.one_rpow, mul_one] using
      relativeRoot_bound_mono hp le_rfl (hA k).le
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one) (hfj k hk)
  simpa only [Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn] using
    hbound z hz 1 le_rfl f g x hf hg houter (fun k hk => hmajor (hgj k hk)) (n - 1)

theorem pointwiseComposition_allJets_fixed_loss
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {X Y : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (inputLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < A n) →
      ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
      ∀ z : E, p base z ≤ 1 → ∀ f : Y → ℝ, ∀ g : X → Y, ∀ x : X,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (g x) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x →
        PointwiseMaterialJetBound p inputLoss A z f (g x) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        PointwiseMaterialJetBound p loss B z (f ∘ g) x := by
  obtain ⟨base, lossC, hcomp⟩ :=
    coordinateComposition_positiveJets_fixed_loss (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := ℝ)
      hp hI inputLoss
  refine ⟨base, max inputLoss lossC, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := hcomp A hA
  refine ⟨fun n => A n + B n, fun n => add_pos (hA n) (hB n), ?_⟩
  intro z hz f g x hf hg hfj hgj n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      have hzero : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (f ∘ g) x‖ ≤
          A 0 * (1 + p (0 + inputLoss) z) := by
        simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Function.comp_apply] using hfj 0
      exact relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_left _ _) (hA 0).le
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hB 0).le) hzero
  | succ n =>
      exact relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_right _ _) (hB (n + 1)).le
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hA (n + 1)).le)
        (hb z hz f g x hf hg (fun k _ => hfj k) hgj (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n))

/-- Forward chart jets and an actual determinant lower bound suffice for
all positive relative jets; the inverse derivatives are proved internally. -/
theorem relativeChart_positiveJets_fixed_loss
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (inputLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < A n) →
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
      ∀ z : E, p base z ≤ 1 → ∀ F G F₀ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint, ∀ x : PolarPoint,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (G (F₀ x)) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ G (F₀ x) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F₀ x →
        F ∘ G =ᶠ[𝓝 (F₀ x)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) →
        G ∘ F =ᶠ[𝓝 (G (F₀ x))] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) →
        κ ≤ |planeJacobian F (G (F₀ x))| →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F (G (F₀ x))‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F₀ x‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (G ∘ F₀) x‖ ≤
          B n * (1 + p (n + loss) z) := by
  obtain ⟨lowI, lossI, hinverse⟩ :=
    planarInverse_positiveJets_of_jacobian_fixed_loss hp hI inputLoss
  let midLoss := max inputLoss lossI
  obtain ⟨lowC, lossC, hcomp⟩ :=
    coordinateComposition_positiveJets_fixed_loss
      (X := PolarPoint) (Y := PolarPoint) (Z := PolarPoint) hp hI midLoss
  refine ⟨max lowI lowC, lossC, ?_⟩
  intro A hA κ hκ
  obtain ⟨I, hIpos, hInv⟩ := hinverse (fun n => 1 + A n)
    (fun n => le_add_of_nonneg_right (hA n).le) κ hκ
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 + A n + I n
  have hQ (n : ℕ) : 0 < Q n := add_pos (add_pos zero_lt_one (hA n)) (hIpos n)
  have hAQ (n : ℕ) : A n ≤ Q n := by dsimp only [Q]; linarith [hIpos n]
  have hIQ (n : ℕ) : I n ≤ Q n := by dsimp only [Q]; linarith [hA n]
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := hcomp Q hQ
  refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z hz F G F₀ x hF hG hF₀ hright hleft hJ hFjets hF₀jets
  have hGjets := hInv z ((hp (le_max_left _ _) z).trans hz)
    F G (F₀ x) hF hG hright hleft hJ
    (fun n hn => relativeRoot_bound_mono hp le_rfl (hA n).le
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one) (hFjets n hn))
  exact hb z ((hp (le_max_right _ _) z).trans hz) G F₀ x hG hF₀
    (fun n hn => relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_right _ _) (hIpos n).le
      (hIQ n) (hGjets n hn))
    (fun n hn => relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_left _ _) (hA n).le
      (hAQ n) (hF₀jets n hn))

/-- The same constants cover a height and its reciprocal: apply this
single product-composition statement to the two actual factor pairs. -/
theorem relativeHeightProduct_allJets_fixed_loss
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) (hI : HasInterpolation p)
    (inputLoss : ℕ) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < A n) →
      ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
      ∀ z : E, p base z ≤ 1 → ∀ f₀ f : PolarPoint → ℝ,
      ∀ g : PolarPoint → PolarPoint, ∀ x : PolarPoint,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f₀ x → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f (g x) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x →
        PointwiseMaterialJetBound p inputLoss A z f₀ x →
        PointwiseMaterialJetBound p inputLoss A z f (g x) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g x‖ ≤
          A n * (1 + p (n + inputLoss) z)) →
        PointwiseMaterialJetBound p loss B z (fun y => f₀ y * f (g y)) x := by
  obtain ⟨lowC, lossC, hcomp⟩ :=
    pointwiseComposition_allJets_fixed_loss (X := PolarPoint) (Y := PolarPoint)
      hp hI inputLoss
  let midLoss := max inputLoss lossC
  obtain ⟨lowP, lossP, hprod⟩ :=
    pointwiseProduct_fixed_loss_material_bound (X := PolarPoint) hp hI midLoss
  refine ⟨max lowC lowP, lossP, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hc⟩ := hcomp A hA
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => A n + C n
  have hQ (n : ℕ) : 0 < Q n := add_pos (hA n) (hC n)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := hprod Q hQ
  refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z hz f₀ f g x hf₀ hf hg hf₀jets hfjets hgjets
  have hcompJets := hc z ((hp (le_max_left _ _) z).trans hz) f g x hf hg hfjets hgjets
  have hscalar : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (f ∘ g) x := hf.comp x hg
  have hbound := hb z ((hp (le_max_right _ _) z).trans hz) f₀ (f ∘ g) x hf₀ hscalar
    (fun n => relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_left _ _) (hA n).le
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hC n).le) (hf₀jets n))
    (fun n => relativeRoot_bound_mono hp (le_max_right _ _) (hC n).le
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hA n).le) (hcompJets n))
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hbound

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual relative root maps on one common neighborhood

The stored inverse germs and the actual zero-circle images are used at
both ends of the composition. The reference root jets are lifted from
zero state displacement. No chart, inverse chart, root, or reference
witness is replaced, and no bound on an angular lift value is requested.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem RootPhysicalFieldJetBound.from_zero
    {E : Type} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} {loss : ℕ} {B : ℕ → ℝ}
    {F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {H : PolarPoint → ℝ} {q : PolarPoint}
    (hB : ∀ n, 0 ≤ B n) (h : RootPhysicalFieldJetBound p loss B 0 F H q) (z : E) :
    RootPhysicalFieldJetBound p loss B z F H q := by
  have hmono (n : ℕ) {v : ℝ} (hv : v ≤ B n * (1 + p (n + loss) 0)) :
      v ≤ B n * (1 + p (n + loss) z) := by
    calc
      v ≤ B n := by simpa only [map_zero, add_zero, mul_one] using hv
      _ = B n * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ B n * (1 + p (n + loss) z) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_right (apply_nonneg _ _)) (hB n)
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, fun n hn => hmono n (h.2.2.2.1 n hn),
    fun n => hmono n (h.2.2.2.2.1 n), fun n => hmono n (h.2.2.2.2.2 n)⟩

private theorem rootBetween_states_radial
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData} {C : NonlinearGeometryData S}
    {K : CanonicalData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (hcut : CanonicalCutGeometry S C K base ε)
    {z₀ z₁ : AnnularState S × ℝ}
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (hs₀ : stateSector S z₀.1)
    (hz₁ : z₁ ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (hs₁ : stateSector S z₁.1)
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
    let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
    let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
    (K.inverseChart z₁ i (K.chart z₀ i (r, θ))).1 = r := by
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  have hroot := canonicalCutRoot_mem_closed_and_zero hA hcut hz₀ hs₀ m side θ
  have hzero : K.inverseChart z₁ i '' ({(0 : ℝ)} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) =
      ({r} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    cases side
    · exact (hcut.2 z₁ hz₁ hs₁ m).2.2.2.2.1
    · exact (hcut.2 z₁ hz₁ hs₁ m).2.2.2.2.2
  have hmem := mem_image_of_mem (K.inverseChart z₁ i)
    (show K.chart z₀ i (r, θ) ∈ ({(0 : ℝ)} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) from
      ⟨hroot.2, mem_univ _⟩)
  rw [hzero] at hmem
  exact hmem.1

def CanonicalRootRelativeJetFamily
    (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (B : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 → ∀ θ : ℝ,
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i) (r, θ) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (canonicalReferencePoint C K z i) (r, θ) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i) (r, θ)‖ ≤
        B n * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (n + loss)
          (z - (C.referenceState, 0)))) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (canonicalReferencePoint C K z i) (r, θ)‖ ≤
        B n * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (n + loss)
          (z - (C.referenceState, 0)))

/-- Actual forward root bounds give both relative directions. The only
smallness change is a common low-order restriction, before any component. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_root_relative_positiveJets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ side : Bool, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
        CanonicalRootRelativeJetFamily S C K newBase outLoss ε' m side B := by
  have hp : Monotone (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) :=
    tamePairGrading_monotone (stateGrading_monotone S) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  have hI := coordinate_hasInterpolation_pair (stateGrading_monotone S)
    (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl) (coordinate_hasInterpolation_stateGrading hS)
    coordinate_hasInterpolation_realGrading
  obtain ⟨rootBase, rootLoss, η, hb, _hrootLow, hη, hηε, hroots⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_endpoint_fields hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  obtain ⟨low, outLoss, hbound⟩ := relativeChart_positiveJets_fixed_loss hp hI rootLoss
  let newBase := max rootBase (max low outLoss)
  let ε' := min η (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hε' : 0 < ε' := lt_min hη (by norm_num)
  have hb' : base ≤ newBase := hb.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hε'ε : ε' ≤ ε := (min_le_left _ _).trans hηε
  have href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hrefRoot : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C rootBase η :=
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C rootBase hη
  have hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  refine ⟨newBase, outLoss, ε', hb', (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _),
    hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro m side
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  obtain ⟨κJ, A, hκJ, hApos, hroots⟩ := hroots m side
  obtain ⟨B, hBpos, hbnd⟩ := hbound A hApos κJ hκJ
  refine ⟨B, hBpos, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [CanonicalRootRelativeJetFamily]
  intro z hz hs θ
  have hzold : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hb' hε'ε hz
  have hzroot : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C rootBase η :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _) hz
  have hzlow : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C low ε' :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)) le_rfl hz
  have hsmall : pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading low
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) ≤ 1 :=
    (pairGrading_displacement_le_two_mul_radius hzlow).trans (by
      have he : ε' ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith only [he])
  have hreference (φ : ℝ) : RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
      (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) i)
      (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) i) (r, φ) :=
    RootPhysicalFieldJetBound.from_zero (fun n => (hApos n).le)
      (by simpa only [sub_self] using (hroots _ hrefRoot hsref φ).2.2) _
  have hcurrent (φ : ℝ) : RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
      (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart z i) (K.height z i) (r, φ) :=
    (hroots z hzroot hs φ).2.2
  have hbetween (z₀ z₁ : AnnularState S × ℝ)
      (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (hs₀ : stateSector S z₀.1)
      (hz₁ : z₁ ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (hs₁ : stateSector S z₁.1)
      (hF₀ : ∀ φ, RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
        (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
        (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart z₀ i) (K.height z₀ i) (r, φ))
      (hF₁ : ∀ φ, RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
        (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
        (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart z₁ i) (K.height z₁ i) (r, φ))
      (hJ₁ : ∀ φ, κJ ≤ |planeJacobian (K.chart z₁ i) (r, φ)|) :
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (K.inverseChart z₁ i ∘ K.chart z₀ i) (r, θ) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (K.inverseChart z₁ i ∘ K.chart z₀ i) (r, θ)‖ ≤
            B n * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (n + outLoss)
              (z - (C.referenceState, 0))) := by
    have hc : (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K z₀ i :=
      (canonicalCutRoot_mem_closed_and_zero hA hB.1 hz₀ hs₀ m side θ).1
    have hq : K.chart z₀ i (r, θ) ∈ canonicalClosed S K i :=
      (hA.boundary z₀ hz₀ hs₀ i).1 hc
    let y := K.inverseChart z₁ i (K.chart z₀ i (r, θ))
    have hy : y = (r, y.2) :=
      Prod.ext (rootBetween_states_radial hA hB.1 hz₀ hs₀ hz₁ hs₁ m side θ) rfl
    have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (K.chart z₁ i) y := by
      rw [hy]
      exact (hF₁ y.2).1
    have hG := n04b_inverseChart_contDiffAt_closed hA hz₁ hs₁ i hq
    have hgerms := canonicalClosed_inverse_germs hA hz₁ hs₁ i hq
    refine ⟨hG.comp (r, θ) (hF₀ θ).1, ?_⟩
    exact hbnd (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) hsmall
      (K.chart z₁ i) (K.inverseChart z₁ i) (K.chart z₀ i) (r, θ)
      hF hG (hF₀ θ).1 hgerms.2 hgerms.1
      (by change κJ ≤ |planeJacobian (K.chart z₁ i) y|; rw [hy]; exact hJ₁ y.2)
      (fun n hn => by
        change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (K.chart z₁ i) y‖ ≤ _
        rw [hy]
        exact (hF₁ y.2).2.2.2.1 n hn)
      (fun n hn => (hF₀ θ).2.2.2.1 n hn)
  have hforward := hbetween (C.referenceState, 0) z href hsref hzold hs
    hreference hcurrent (fun φ => (hroots z hzroot hs φ).2.1)
  have hinverse := hbetween z (C.referenceState, 0) hzold hs href hsref
    hcurrent hreference (fun φ => (hroots _ hrefRoot hsref φ).2.1)
  exact ⟨hforward.1, hinverse.1, hforward.2, hinverse.2⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Jets of the actual relative root height

Both factors come from the same stored root charts. The current height
is evaluated at the genuine relative transport, whose image stays on
that same root circle. One product-composition estimate covers the
height ratio and its reciprocal without an additional inverse estimate.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def CanonicalRootHeightJetFamily
    (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (B : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 → ∀ θ : ℝ,
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i) (r, θ) ∧
      0 < n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i (r, θ) ∧
      PointwiseMaterialJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        loss B (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i) (r, θ) ∧
      PointwiseMaterialJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        loss B (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
        (fun y => (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i y)⁻¹) (r, θ)

/-- The common neighborhood and loss precede the component. The actual
stored height and transport are unchanged throughout the construction. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_root_heightJets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ side : Bool, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 < B n) ∧
        CanonicalRootHeightJetFamily S C K newBase outLoss ε' m side B := by
  have hp : Monotone (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) :=
    tamePairGrading_monotone (stateGrading_monotone S) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  have hI := coordinate_hasInterpolation_pair (stateGrading_monotone S)
    (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl) (coordinate_hasInterpolation_stateGrading hS)
    coordinate_hasInterpolation_realGrading
  obtain ⟨rootBase, rootLoss, ηR, hbR, _hRlow, hηR, hηRε, hroots⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_endpoint_fields hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  obtain ⟨relativeBase, relativeLoss, ηT, hbT, _hTlow, hηT, hηTε, hrelative⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_relative_positiveJets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  let inputLoss := max rootLoss relativeLoss
  obtain ⟨low, outLoss, hproduct⟩ :=
    relativeHeightProduct_allJets_fixed_loss hp hI inputLoss
  let newBase := max rootBase (max relativeBase (max low outLoss))
  let ε' := min (min ηR ηT) (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hε' : 0 < ε' := lt_min (lt_min hηR hηT) (by norm_num)
  have hbaseR : rootBase ≤ newBase := le_max_left _ _
  have hbaseT : relativeBase ≤ newBase := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbaseLow : low ≤ newBase :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hbaseOut : outLoss ≤ newBase :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hε'R : ε' ≤ ηR := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε'T : ε' ≤ ηT := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hb' : base ≤ newBase := hbR.trans hbaseR
  have hε'ε : ε' ≤ ε := hε'R.trans hηRε
  have href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hrefR : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C rootBase ηR :=
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C rootBase hηR
  have hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  refine ⟨newBase, outLoss, ε', hb', hbaseOut, hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro m side
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  obtain ⟨κJ, A, _hκJ, hApos, hroot⟩ := hroots m side
  obtain ⟨R, hRpos, hrel⟩ := hrelative m side
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => A n + R n
  have hQ (n : ℕ) : 0 < Q n := add_pos (hApos n) (hRpos n)
  have hAQ (n : ℕ) : A n ≤ Q n := le_add_of_nonneg_right (hRpos n).le
  have hRQ (n : ℕ) : R n ≤ Q n := le_add_of_nonneg_left (hApos n).le
  obtain ⟨B, hBpos, hbnd⟩ := hproduct Q hQ
  refine ⟨B, hBpos, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [CanonicalRootHeightJetFamily]
  intro z hz hs θ
  let τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i
  have hzold : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hb' hε'ε hz
  have hzR : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C rootBase ηR :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hbaseR hε'R hz
  have hzT : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C relativeBase ηT :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hbaseT hε'T hz
  have hzlow : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C low ε' :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hbaseLow le_rfl hz
  have hsmall : pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading low
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) ≤ 1 :=
    (pairGrading_displacement_le_two_mul_radius hzlow).trans (by
      have he : ε' ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith only [he])
  have hrelative := hrel z hzT hs θ
  have hτ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ (r, θ) := hrelative.1
  have hy : τ (r, θ) = (r, (τ (r, θ)).2) :=
    Prod.ext (canonicalCurrentPoint_root_radial hA hB.1 href hsref hzold hs m side θ) rfl
  have hcurrent : RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
      (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart z i) (K.height z i) (τ (r, θ)) := by
    rw [hy]
    exact (hroot z hzR hs (τ (r, θ)).2).2.2
  have hreference : RootPhysicalFieldJetBound
      (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) rootLoss A
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) i)
      (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) i) (r, θ) :=
    RootPhysicalFieldJetBound.from_zero (fun n => (hApos n).le)
      (by simpa only [sub_self] using (hroot _ hrefR hsref θ).2.2) _
  have hheight {f : PolarPoint → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
      (hf : PointwiseMaterialJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        rootLoss A (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) f p) :
      PointwiseMaterialJetBound (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
        inputLoss Q (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) f p :=
    hf.mono hp (le_max_left _ _) (fun n => (hApos n).le) hAQ
  have hτjets (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n τ (r, θ)‖ ≤
        Q n * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (n + inputLoss)
          (z - (C.referenceState, 0))) :=
    (hrelative.2.2.1 n hn).trans (mul_le_mul (hRQ n)
      (add_le_add le_rfl (hp (Nat.add_le_add_left (le_max_right _ _) n) _))
      (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _)) (hQ n).le)
  have hqjets := hbnd (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) hsmall
    (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) i) (fun y => (K.height z i y)⁻¹) τ (r, θ)
    hreference.2.1 (hcurrent.2.1.inv hcurrent.2.2.1.ne') hτ
    (hheight hreference.2.2.2.2.1) (hheight hcurrent.2.2.2.2.2) hτjets
  have hinvjets := hbnd (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) hsmall
    (fun y => (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) i y)⁻¹) (K.height z i) τ (r, θ)
    (hreference.2.1.inv hreference.2.2.1.ne') hcurrent.2.1 hτ
    (hheight hreference.2.2.2.2.2) (hheight hcurrent.2.2.2.2.1) hτjets
  have hclosed : (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K (C.referenceState, 0) i :=
    (canonicalCutRoot_mem_closed_and_zero hA hB.1 href hsref m side θ).1
  have hq := n04Coordinates_currentHeightRatio_contDiffAt_pos_closed
    hA href hsref hzold hs i hclosed
  refine ⟨hq.1, hq.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio, div_eq_mul_inv, τ] using hqjets
  · have he : (fun y => (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i y)⁻¹) =
        (fun y => (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) i y)⁻¹ * K.height z i (τ y)) := by
      funext y
      simp only [n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, τ]
    rw [he]
    exact hinvjets

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PlanarInverseDerivativeBound

/-!
# Quantitative diagonal bounds at actual fixed root circles

The actual inverse derivative is a left inverse. Since the root circle
is fixed, the forward derivative is triangular there. A norm bound on
the inverse therefore bounds both positive diagonal entries from below.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

private theorem root_triangular_diagonal_lower
    (A B : PolarPoint →L[ℝ] PolarPoint) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hleft : B.comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ PolarPoint)
    (hzero : (A (0, 1)).1 = 0)
    (ha : 0 < (A (1, 0)).1) (hd : 0 < (A (0, 1)).2) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ M) :
    M⁻¹ ≤ (A (1, 0)).1 ∧ M⁻¹ ≤ (A (0, 1)).2 := by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun L : PolarPoint →L[ℝ] PolarPoint => L (1, 0)) hleft
  have h2 := congrArg (fun L : PolarPoint →L[ℝ] PolarPoint => L (0, 1)) hleft
  change B (A (1, 0)) = (1, 0) at h1
  change B (A (0, 1)) = (0, 1) at h2
  rw [planeCLM_apply_decompose B (A (1, 0))] at h1
  rw [planeCLM_apply_decompose B (A (0, 1))] at h2
  have h12 : (A (0, 1)).2 * (B (0, 1)).1 = 0 := by
    simpa only [hzero, zero_mul, zero_add] using congrArg Prod.fst h2
  have hB12 : (B (0, 1)).1 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h12).resolve_left hd.ne'
  have h11 : (A (1, 0)).1 * (B (1, 0)).1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [hB12, mul_zero, add_zero] using congrArg Prod.fst h1
  have h22 : (A (0, 1)).2 * (B (0, 1)).2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [hzero, zero_mul, zero_add] using congrArg Prod.snd h2
  have hnorm (v : PolarPoint) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) : ‖B v‖ ≤ M :=
    (B.le_opNorm v).trans ((mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg B) hv).trans hB)
  have hb11 : (B (1, 0)).1 ≤ M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |(B (1, 0)).1| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖B (1, 0)‖ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_fst_le (B (1, 0))
      _ ≤ M := hnorm (1, 0) (by norm_num [Prod.norm_def])
  have hb22 : (B (0, 1)).2 ≤ M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |(B (0, 1)).2| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖B (0, 1)‖ := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_snd_le (B (0, 1))
      _ ≤ M := hnorm (0, 1) (by norm_num [Prod.norm_def])
  have hlower (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a * b = 1) (hb : b ≤ M) : M⁻¹ ≤ a := by
    apply (inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ hM).mpr
    calc
      1 = a * b := hab.symm
      _ ≤ a * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb ha.le
  exact ⟨hlower _ _ ha h11 hb11, hlower _ _ hd h22 hb22⟩

/-- Only a first-derivative bound for the genuine inverse is supplied.
The triangularity, inverse identity and positivity come from actual
Part A and cut geometry, on the same root circle and same state. -/
theorem canonicalCurrentPoint_root_diagonal_lower
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {K : CanonicalData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (hcut : CanonicalCutGeometry S C K base ε)
    (href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hbound :
      let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
      let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
      ‖fderiv ℝ (canonicalReferencePoint C K z i)
        (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i (r, θ))‖ ≤ M) :
    let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
    let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
    M⁻¹ ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i p).1) (r, θ) ∧
      M⁻¹ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i p).2) (r, θ) := by
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  let F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i
  let G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalReferencePoint C K z i
  have hclosed : (r, θ) ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K (C.referenceState, 0) i :=
    (canonicalCutRoot_mem_closed_and_zero hA hcut href hsref m side θ).1
  have hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (r, θ) :=
    (n04Coordinates_currentPoint_contDiffAt_closed hA href hsref hz hs i hclosed).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hG := canonicalCurrentPoint_closed_inverse_data hA href hsref hz hs i hclosed
  have hgerm : G ∘ F =ᶠ[𝓝 (r, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) := hG.2.1
  have hleft : (fderiv ℝ G (F (r, θ))).comp (fderiv ℝ F (r, θ)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ PolarPoint := by
    rw [← fderiv_comp (r, θ) (hG.1.differentiableAt (by simp)) hF,
      hgerm.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  have he : (fun η => (F (r, η)).1) = (fun _ : ℝ => r) :=
    funext (canonicalCurrentPoint_root_radial hA hcut href hsref hz hs m side)
  have hzpartial := (hasDerivAt_angular_slice hF.fst).deriv
  rw [he, deriv_const] at hzpartial
  have hzero : (fderiv ℝ F (r, θ) (0, 1)).1 = 0 := by
    have hh := hzpartial.symm
    dsimp only [angularPartial] at hh
    rw [(hF.hasFDerivAt.fst).fderiv] at hh
    exact hh
  have hpos := canonicalCurrentPoint_root_positive_diagonal hA hcut href hsref hz hs m side θ
  change 0 < radialPartial (fun p => (F p).1) (r, θ) ∧
    0 < angularPartial (fun p => (F p).2) (r, θ) at hpos
  change M⁻¹ ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (F p).1) (r, θ) ∧
    M⁻¹ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (F p).2) (r, θ)
  dsimp only [radialPartial, angularPartial] at hpos ⊢
  rw [(hF.hasFDerivAt.fst).fderiv, (hF.hasFDerivAt.snd).fderiv] at hpos ⊢
  exact root_triangular_diagonal_lower _ _ hM hleft hzero hpos.1 hpos.2 hbound

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual finite endpoint bounds from the same Through03 witness

The low state order is increased once, before any component. The already
proved root jet families then give finite numerical envelopes. Their
inverse first jet supplies the positive diagonal lower bound. No raw
endpoint estimate or state-uniform coefficient collar is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure RootEndpointJetBounds (n : ℕ)
    (F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (q : PolarPoint → ℝ) (r κ M H : ℝ) : Prop where
  radial_lower : ∀ θ, κ ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (F p).1) (r, θ)
  angular_lower : ∀ θ, κ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (F p).2) (r, θ)
  coordinate_jets : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 2 → ∀ θ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (r, θ)‖ ≤ M
  height_value : ∀ θ, q (r, θ) ≤ H
  height_inverse : ∀ θ, (q (r, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H
  height_jets : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q (r, θ)‖ ≤ H

private def rootFiniteEnvelope (N : ℕ) (A : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 2 * A k

private theorem rootFiniteEnvelope_one_le (N : ℕ) {A : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ k, 0 < A k) : 1 ≤ rootFiniteEnvelope N A := by
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hA k).le)

private theorem rootFiniteEnvelope_term {N k : ℕ} {A : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ k, 0 < A k) (hk : k ≤ N) : 2 * A k ≤ rootFiniteEnvelope N A := by
  have ht : 2 * A k ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), 2 * A j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hA j).le)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk))
  exact ht.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)

/-- Every finite-order endpoint bound is derived for the actual maps and
heights. The output neighborhood is common to all negative components
and both ends; only the finite constants depend on the component. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_root_finite_endpoint_bounds
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ newBase : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ side : Bool, ∃ κ M H : ℝ,
        0 < κ ∧ κ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
          let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
          RootEndpointJetBounds n (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i)
            (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i)
            (n01ComponentRoot C m side) κ M H := by
  have hp : Monotone (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) :=
    tamePairGrading_monotone (stateGrading_monotone S) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  obtain ⟨relativeBase, relativeLoss, ηT, hbT, _hTlow, hηT, hηTε, hrelative⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_relative_positiveJets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  obtain ⟨heightBase, heightLoss, ηH, hbH, _hHlow, hηH, hηHε, hheight⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_heightJets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  let newBase := max relativeBase
    (max heightBase (max (n + 2 + relativeLoss) (n + heightLoss)))
  let ε' := min (min ηT ηH) (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hbaseT : relativeBase ≤ newBase := le_max_left _ _
  have hbaseH : heightBase ≤ newBase := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have horderT : n + 2 + relativeLoss ≤ newBase :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have horderH : n + heightLoss ≤ newBase :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hε'T : ε' ≤ ηT := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε'H : ε' ≤ ηH := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hb' : base ≤ newBase := hbT.trans hbaseT
  have hε' : 0 < ε' := lt_min (lt_min hηT hηH) (by norm_num)
  have hε'ε : ε' ≤ ε := hε'T.trans hηTε
  have href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  refine ⟨newBase, ε', hb', hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro m side
  let i := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  let r := n01ComponentRoot C m side
  obtain ⟨A, hApos, hrel⟩ := hrelative m side
  obtain ⟨B, hBpos, hheights⟩ := hheight m side
  let M := rootFiniteEnvelope (n + 2) A
  let H := rootFiniteEnvelope n B
  have hMone : 1 ≤ M := rootFiniteEnvelope_one_le (n + 2) hApos
  have hHone : 1 ≤ H := rootFiniteEnvelope_one_le n hBpos
  have hM : 0 < M := zero_lt_one.trans_le hMone
  refine ⟨M⁻¹, M, H, inv_pos.mpr hM, inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hMone,
    hMone, hHone, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hs
  have hzold : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hb' hε'ε hz
  have hzT : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C relativeBase ηT :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hbaseT hε'T hz
  have hzH : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C heightBase ηH :=
    stateNeighborhood_mono S C hbaseH hε'H hz
  have hsmall : pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading newBase
      (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) ≤ 1 :=
    (pairGrading_displacement_le_two_mul_radius hz).trans (by
      have he : ε' ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith only [he])
  have hfinite {N k d : ℕ} {Q : ℕ → ℝ} (hQ : ∀ k, 0 < Q k)
      (hk : k ≤ N) (hNd : N + d ≤ newBase) {v : ℝ}
      (hv : v ≤ Q k * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (k + d)
        (z - (C.referenceState, 0)))) : v ≤ rootFiniteEnvelope N Q := by
    have hg : pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (k + d)
        (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) ≤ 1 :=
      (hp ((Nat.add_le_add_right hk d).trans hNd) _).trans hsmall
    calc
      v ≤ Q k * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (k + d)
        (z - (C.referenceState, 0))) := hv
      _ ≤ Q k * (1 + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_left hg 1) (hQ k).le
      _ = 2 * Q k := by ring
      _ ≤ rootFiniteEnvelope N Q := rootFiniteEnvelope_term hQ hk
  have hcoordinate (θ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n + 2) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i) (r, θ)‖ ≤ M :=
    hfinite hApos hkn horderT ((hrel z hzT hs θ).2.2.1 k hk)
  have hdiagonal (θ : ℝ) :
      M⁻¹ ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i p).1) (r, θ) ∧
        M⁻¹ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i p).2) (r, θ) := by
    let τ := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z i
    have hy : τ (r, θ) = (r, (τ (r, θ)).2) :=
      Prod.ext (canonicalCurrentPoint_root_radial hA hB.1 href hsref hzold hs m side θ) rfl
    have hInv : ‖fderiv ℝ (canonicalReferencePoint C K z i) (τ (r, θ))‖ ≤ M := by
      rw [hy]
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] using
        hfinite hApos (show 1 ≤ n + 2 by omega) horderT
          ((hrel z hzT hs (τ (r, θ)).2).2.2.2 1 le_rfl)
    exact canonicalCurrentPoint_root_diagonal_lower
      hA hB.1 href hsref hzold hs m side θ hM hInv
  refine {
    radial_lower := fun θ => (hdiagonal θ).1
    angular_lower := fun θ => (hdiagonal θ).2
    coordinate_jets := fun k hk hkn θ => hcoordinate θ k hk hkn
    height_value := ?_
    height_inverse := ?_
    height_jets := ?_ }
  · intro θ
    have hh : |n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i (r, θ)| ≤ H := by
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        hfinite hBpos (Nat.zero_le n) horderH ((hheights z hzH hs θ).2.2.1 0)
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hh
  · intro θ
    have hh : |(n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z i (r, θ))⁻¹| ≤ H := by
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        hfinite hBpos (Nat.zero_le n) horderH ((hheights z hzH hs θ).2.2.2 0)
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hh
  · intro k _hk hkn θ
    exact hfinite hBpos hkn horderH ((hheights z hzH hs θ).2.2.1 k)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Derived finite bounds for the actual positive endpoint sources

The certified source of each end is fixed before the state. A negative
neighbor uses its actual opposite root; an ambient end uses identity and
height one. The numerical lower/upper envelopes combine the two ends,
without changing the stored atlas or requiring a common material cell.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff

private theorem rootEndpointJetBounds_identity (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    RootEndpointJetBounds n (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (fun _ => 1) r 1 1 1 := by
  refine {
    radial_lower := ?_
    angular_lower := ?_
    coordinate_jets := ?_
    height_value := fun _ => le_rfl
    height_inverse := ?_
    height_jets := ?_ }
  · intro θ
    simp only [id_eq, radialPartial_fst, le_refl]
  · intro θ
    simp only [id_eq, angularPartial_snd, le_refl]
  · intro k hk _hkn θ
    exact (flowJet_norm_iteratedFDeriv_clm_le
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ PolarPoint) hk (r, θ)).trans
      (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := PolarPoint))
  · intro θ
    simp only [inv_one, le_refl]
  · intro k hk _hkn θ
    cases k with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_const]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero, zero_le_one]

/-- All six finite input clauses of the whole-positive construction are
proved for the actual source maps. The common base/radius are chosen
before positive components, source choices and numerical envelopes. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_positive_endpoint_bounds
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {E : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C E L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ newBase : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ κ M H : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ ≤ 1 ∧ κ⁻¹ ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
          WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n
            (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z)
            (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
            (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κ κ M H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨newBase, ε', hb, hε', hε'ε, hroots⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_finite_endpoint_bounds hS hT hN hfield hA hB n
  refine ⟨newBase, ε', hb, hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hsource (side : Bool) (j : N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side) :
      ∃ κ M H : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ ≤ 1 ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
          RootEndpointJetBounds n (n04PositiveSourceMap j K z)
            (n04PositiveSourceHeight j K z) (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) κ M H := by
    rcases j with ⟨o, ho⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
        refine ⟨1, 1, 1, zero_lt_one, le_rfl, le_rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
        intro z _hz _hs
        exact rootEndpointJetBounds_identity n (n04PositiveEndpoint i side)
    | some m =>
        obtain ⟨κ, M, H, hκ, hκone, hM, hH, hbound⟩ := hroots m (!side)
        refine ⟨κ, M, H, hκ, hκone, hM, hH, ?_⟩
        intro z hz hs
        change RootEndpointJetBounds n
          (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z (if side then (K.cutPair m).1 else (K.cutPair m).2))
          (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z
            (if side then (K.cutPair m).1 else (K.cutPair m).2))
          (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) κ M H
        change n04PositiveEndpoint i side = (if side then C.left m else C.right m) at ho
        rw [ho]
        have hh := hbound z hz hs
        cases side <;> exact hh
  choose κ M H hκ hκone hM hH hbound using fun side => hsource side (j side)
  let κ₀ := min (κ false) (κ true)
  let M₀ := max (max (M false) (M true)) κ₀⁻¹
  let H₀ := max (H false) (H true)
  have hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀ := lt_min (hκ false) (hκ true)
  have hκ₀one : κ₀ ≤ 1 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (hκone false)
  have hM₀ : 1 ≤ M₀ := (hM false).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hκ₀inv : κ₀⁻¹ ≤ M₀ := le_max_right _ _
  have hH₀ : 1 ≤ H₀ := (hH false).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hκside (side : Bool) : κ₀ ≤ κ side := by
    cases side
    · exact min_le_left _ _
    · exact min_le_right _ _
  have hMside (side : Bool) : M side ≤ M₀ := by
    apply le_trans (b := max (M false) (M true)) _ (le_max_left _ _)
    cases side
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_right _ _
  have hHside (side : Bool) : H side ≤ H₀ := by
    cases side
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨κ₀, M₀, H₀, hκ₀, hκ₀one, hκ₀inv, hM₀, hH₀, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hs
  have hf (side : Bool) := hbound side z hz hs
  exact {
    angular_lower := fun side θ => (hκside side).trans ((hf side).angular_lower θ)
    radial_lower := fun side θ => (hκside side).trans ((hf side).radial_lower θ)
    coordinate_jets := fun side k hk hkn θ =>
      ((hf side).coordinate_jets k hk hkn θ).trans (hMside side)
    height_value := fun side θ => ((hf side).height_value θ).trans (hHside side)
    height_inverse := fun side θ => ((hf side).height_inverse θ).trans (hHside side)
    height_jets := fun side k hk hkn θ =>
      ((hf side).height_jets k hk hkn θ).trans (hHside side) }

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Part B for the same actual typed charts

The actual typed atlas already stores the inverse-coordinate operator
fields. Its genuine negative root density and cut transmission supply
Part B after replacing only the unused interior divided-difference field.
This preliminary completion does not use a whole-positive atlas, any
endpoint bound, or any positive interpolation.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

/-- Complete only the divided field; every chart, inverse, height, root,
physical domain and state-dependent function is the original chosen one. -/
theorem n04bActualTypedAtlas_interiorCompletion_partB
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) :
    N04PartB S C L
      (n04bWithInteriorDivision C (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e)) base ε := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  have hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε :=
    n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e
  have hfields (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
      K.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, K.potential z m p = (if K.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) p :=
    ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  apply n04bWithInteriorDivision_partB_of_parts
  · exact n04bActualTypedAtlas_cutGeometry hT hS hN hfield e
  · intro z hz hs u hu m θ
    exact n04ActualAtlas_transmission hT hS hN hfield e hz hs u hu m θ
  · intro z hz hs m u hu p hp
    have hx : K.inverseChart z m p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z m :=
      (hA.charts z hz hs m).2.1 hp
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := n04b_field_contDiffAt_on_piece hA hfield hz hs m hx
    have hop := n04b_canonicalOperator_explicit_fields hA hz hs m hp ha hb hc u hu
    have hf := hfields z m
    rw [← hf.1, ← hf.2 p] at hop
    exact hop
  · intro z hz hs k hk p hp
    have hx : K.inverseChart z k p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z k :=
      (hA.charts z hz hs k).2.1 hp
    have hFx : K.chart z k (K.inverseChart z k p) = p :=
      (hA.charts z hz hs k).2.2.2.1 p hp
    cases hi : e k with
    | inl j =>
        have hxraw : K.inverseChart z k p ∈
            n04bTypedPhysicalDomain (D := D) C (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z) (.inl j) := by
          simpa only [K, n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData_physicalPieceOpen, hi]
            using hx
        have hxfull := n04b_typed_negative_domain_subset j hxraw
        have hd := n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_negativePrincipalDensity
          hT hS hN hfield e hz hs k j.1 j.2 hi hxfull
        rw [(hfields z k).1]
        simpa only [inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients, hFx] using hd
    | inr i =>
        have htrue : K.positive k = true := by
          simp only [K, n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData_positive, hi,
            n04TypedPiecePositive]
        rw [htrue] at hk
        cases hk

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis
