/-!
# The actual whole-positive family with its endpoint inputs derived

The original typed atlas is kept after the common state neighborhood is
shrunk. The preliminary interior completion changes no source map or
height. Actual endpoint bounds then feed the existing finite family
constructor, with one inverse-fiber constant and one height collar for
all states. The normalization-buffer centers remain free ordered inputs.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

/-- The original actual typed atlas, without rebuilding it on the smaller
neighborhood, satisfies the six finite endpoint input clauses. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actual_positiveEndpoint_bounds
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ newBase : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ κ M H : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ ≤ 1 ∧ κ⁻¹ ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
          let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
          WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n
            (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z)
            (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
            (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κ κ M H := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  have hA := n04bWithInteriorDivision_partA
    (n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e)
  have hB := n04bActualTypedAtlas_interiorCompletion_partB hT hS hN hfield e
  have hfinite := n04b_exists_common_positive_endpoint_bounds hS hT hN hfield hA hB n
  simpa only [n04PositiveSourceMap, n04PositiveSourceHeight,
    canonicalCurrentPoint, n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio, n04bWithInteriorDivision]
    using hfinite

/-- No endpoint-bound hypothesis remains. The common base and radius
precede all components. Each component then selects finite envelopes,
and any ordered buffer centers give the actual common family. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_exists_actual_wholePositive_families
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ newBase : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ κ M H : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ κ ≤ 1 ∧ κ⁻¹ ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧
      ∀ c d : ℝ, n04PositiveLeft i < c → c < d → d < n04PositiveRight i →
        let l := n04PositiveLeft i
        let r := n04PositiveRight i
        let ρ := min ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
        ∃ Clog Mσ δ : ℝ, 0 < Clog ∧ 1 ≤ Mσ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
          δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) ∧
          0 < endpointFiberLower n l r c d κ Mσ ∧
          ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
            let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
            let F := fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z
            let q := fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z
            let ψ := fun side p => (F side p).2
            let X := fun side p => (F side p).1
            let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n ψ X l r c d κ κ M Mσ
            let σ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n ψ X l r c d κ κ M Mσ
            let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) q
            WholePositiveTransportMatching n F q τ σ Q l r c d
              (endpointFiberLower n l r c d κ Mσ * (κ / 2)) (Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2) ∧
              (z = (C.referenceState, 0) → τ = id ∧ σ = id ∧ Q = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := by
  obtain ⟨newBase, ε', hb, hε', hε'ε, hfinite⟩ :=
    n04Coordinates_actual_positiveEndpoint_bounds hT hS hN hfield e n
  refine ⟨newBase, ε', hb, hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨κ, M, H, hκ, hκone, hκinv, hM, hH, hbounds⟩ := hfinite i j
  refine ⟨κ, M, H, hκ, hκone, hκinv, hM, hH, ?_⟩
  intro c d hlc hcd hdr
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let Z := {z : AnnularState S × ℝ //
    z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε' ∧ stateSector S z.1}
  let z₀ : Z := ⟨(C.referenceState, 0),
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C newBase hε', hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector⟩
  let a : Bool → ℝ := fun side => n04PositiveSourceLeft (j side)
  let b : Bool → ℝ := fun side => n04PositiveSourceRight (j side)
  let F : Z → Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint := fun z side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z.1
  let q : Z → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun z side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z.1
  have hdata (z : Z) (side : Bool) :
      OneSidedTransportEndpoint (F z side) (q z side) (a side) (b side)
        (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i) :=
    n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_positiveEndpoint_of_source hT hS hN hfield e (j side)
      (stateNeighborhood_mono S C hb hε'ε z.2.1) z.2.2
  have hf (z : Z) : WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n (F z) (q z)
      (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κ κ M H :=
    hbounds z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2
  have href (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      F z₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i, θ)]
          (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) ∧
        q z₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i, θ)]
          (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
    n04Coordinates_positiveSource_reference_germs hT hS hN hfield e (j side) θ
  have hout := exists_wholePositiveTransport_family (F := F) (q := q) (a := a) (b := b)
    (l := n04PositiveLeft i) (r := n04PositiveRight i) z₀ n
    hlc hcd hdr hκ hκone hκ (zero_le_one.trans hM) hH hdata
    (fun z => (hf z).angular_lower) (fun z => (hf z).radial_lower)
    (fun z => (hf z).coordinate_jets) (fun z => (hf z).height_value)
    (fun z => (hf z).height_inverse) (fun z => (hf z).height_jets) href
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hs
  let z' : Z := ⟨z, hz, hs⟩
  have hzout := hout z'
  refine ⟨hzout.1, ?_⟩
  intro he
  exact hzout.2 (Subtype.ext he)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# All ordinary jets of the same certified positive endpoint sources

The common neighborhood and loss precede every component and derivative
order. The source is the retained negative root field or the actual
ambient identity. Its high-order coefficient is independent of the state;
only the single displayed high grading depends on the state. This does
not assert material growth of those component coefficients.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped ContDiff BigOperators

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure RootEndpointTameJetBounds {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (loss : ℕ) (A : ℕ → ℝ) (z : E)
    (F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (q : PolarPoint → ℝ) (r : ℝ) : Prop where
  coordinate_jets : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ θ : ℝ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (r, θ)‖ ≤ A k * (1 + p (k + loss) z)
  height_jets : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q (r, θ)‖ ≤ A k * (1 + p (k + loss) z)
  inverse_height_jets : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => (q y)⁻¹) (r, θ)‖ ≤ A k * (1 + p (k + loss) z)

theorem RootEndpointTameJetBounds.mono_envelope
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} {loss : ℕ} {A B : ℕ → ℝ} {z : E}
    {F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (h : RootEndpointTameJetBounds p loss A z F q r) (hAB : ∀ k, A k ≤ B k) :
    RootEndpointTameJetBounds p loss B z F q r := by
  have he (k : ℕ) : A k * (1 + p (k + loss) z) ≤ B k * (1 + p (k + loss) z) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hAB k) (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _))
  exact {
    coordinate_jets := fun k hk θ => (h.coordinate_jets k hk θ).trans (he k)
    height_jets := fun k θ => (h.height_jets k θ).trans (he k)
    inverse_height_jets := fun k θ => (h.inverse_height_jets k θ).trans (he k) }

private theorem rootEndpointTameJetBounds_identity
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E) (loss : ℕ) (z : E) (r : ℝ) :
    RootEndpointTameJetBounds p loss (fun _ => 1) z id (fun _ => 1) r := by
  have hone (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (1 + p (k + loss) z) := by
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (apply_nonneg (p (k + loss)) z)
  have hconst (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun _ : PolarPoint => (1 : ℝ)) (r, θ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    cases k with
    | zero => simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, le_refl]
    | succ k =>
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_const]
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero, zero_le_one]
  exact {
    coordinate_jets := fun k hk θ =>
      ((flowJet_norm_iteratedFDeriv_clm_le (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ PolarPoint) hk (r, θ)).trans
        (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := PolarPoint))).trans (hone k)
    height_jets := fun k θ => (hconst k θ).trans (hone k)
    inverse_height_jets := fun k θ => by
      simpa only [inv_one] using (hconst k θ).trans (hone k) }

/-- Certified endpoint selection preserves the actual all-order root
estimates. Both ends use one envelope and one common derivative loss. -/
theorem n04b_exists_common_positive_source_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (hA : N04PartA D S C K base ε) (hB : N04PartB S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 1 ≤ A k) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 → ∀ side,
          RootEndpointTameJetBounds (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            outLoss A (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
            (n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z) (n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
            (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) := by
  classical
  have hp : Monotone (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) :=
    tamePairGrading_monotone (stateGrading_monotone S) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  obtain ⟨bF, lF, εF, hbF, hlF, hεF, hεFε, hF⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_relative_positiveJets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  obtain ⟨bQ, lQ, εQ, hbQ, hlQ, hεQ, hεQε, hQ⟩ :=
    n04b_exists_common_root_heightJets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  let newBase := max bF bQ
  let outLoss := max lF lQ
  let ε' := min εF εQ
  refine ⟨newBase, outLoss, ε', hbF.trans (le_max_left _ _), max_le_max hlF hlQ,
    lt_min hεF hεQ, (min_le_left _ _).trans hεFε, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hsource (side : Bool) (j : N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side) :
      ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 1 ≤ A k) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 →
          RootEndpointTameJetBounds (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            outLoss A (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
            (n04PositiveSourceMap j K z) (n04PositiveSourceHeight j K z)
            (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) := by
    rcases j with ⟨o, ho⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
        exact ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => le_rfl, fun z _hz _hs =>
          rootEndpointTameJetBounds_identity _ outLoss (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) _⟩
    | some m =>
        obtain ⟨A, hApos, hrelative⟩ := hF m (!side)
        obtain ⟨B, hBpos, hheight⟩ := hQ m (!side)
        let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 + A k + B k
        have hQone (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Q k := by
          dsimp only [Q]
          linarith only [hApos k, hBpos k]
        have hAQ (k : ℕ) : A k ≤ Q k := by
          dsimp only [Q]
          linarith only [hBpos k]
        have hBQ (k : ℕ) : B k ≤ Q k := by
          dsimp only [Q]
          linarith only [hApos k]
        refine ⟨Q, hQone, ?_⟩
        intro z hz hs
        have hzF := stateNeighborhood_mono S C (le_max_left bF bQ)
          (min_le_left εF εQ) hz
        have hzQ := stateNeighborhood_mono S C (le_max_right bF bQ)
          (min_le_right εF εQ) hz
        have hraise (a : ℕ → ℝ) (haQ : ∀ k, a k ≤ Q k)
            (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ outLoss) (k : ℕ) :
            a k * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (k + l)
              (z - (C.referenceState, 0))) ≤
            Q k * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (k + outLoss)
              (z - (C.referenceState, 0))) :=
          mul_le_mul (haQ k)
            (add_le_add le_rfl (hp (Nat.add_le_add_left hl k) _))
            (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _)) (zero_le_one.trans (hQone k))
        change RootEndpointTameJetBounds _ outLoss Q _
          (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z (if side then (K.cutPair m).1 else (K.cutPair m).2))
          (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z
            (if side then (K.cutPair m).1 else (K.cutPair m).2))
          (n04PositiveEndpoint i side)
        change n04PositiveEndpoint i side = (if side then C.left m else C.right m) at ho
        rw [ho]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro k hk θ
          have h := ((hrelative z hzF hs θ).2.2.1 k hk).trans
            (hraise A hAQ lF (le_max_left _ _) k)
          cases side <;> exact h
        · intro k θ
          have h := ((hheight z hzQ hs θ).2.2.1 k).trans
            (hraise B hBQ lQ (le_max_right _ _) k)
          cases side <;> exact h
        · intro k θ
          have h := ((hheight z hzQ hs θ).2.2.2 k).trans
            (hraise B hBQ lQ (le_max_right _ _) k)
          cases side <;> exact h
  choose A hAone hbound using fun side => hsource side (j side)
  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => A false k + A true k
  have hB (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ B k := by
    dsimp only [B]
    linarith only [hAone false k, hAone true k]
  have hAB (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) : A side k ≤ B k := by
    cases side
    · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le_one.trans (hAone true k))
    · exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (zero_le_one.trans (hAone false k))
  exact ⟨B, hB, fun z hz hs side => (hbound side z hz hs).mono_envelope (hAB side)⟩

/-- The temporary completion affects no source field. These all-order
estimates therefore apply to the original actual typed atlas itself. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actual_positiveSource_allJets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 1 ≤ A k) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε', stateSector S z.1 → ∀ side,
          let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
          RootEndpointTameJetBounds (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            outLoss A (z - (C.referenceState, 0))
            (n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z) (n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
            (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) := by
  have hA := n04bWithInteriorDivision_partA
    (n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e)
  have hB := n04bActualTypedAtlas_interiorCompletion_partB hT hS hN hfield e
  have hout := n04b_exists_common_positive_source_jets hS hT hN hfield hA hB
  simpa only [n04PositiveSourceMap, n04PositiveSourceHeight,
    canonicalCurrentPoint, n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio, n04bWithInteriorDivision]
    using hout

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# A single high-data envelope for the retained endpoint family

The finite sum is chosen before the state and is linear in its one high
grading. It supplies the positive coordinate and full height jets needed
at any requested order. This operation never selects an interpolation
width, changes its fixed construction order, or changes the stored atlas.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

theorem exists_rootEndpointTameJet_finite_prefix_envelope
    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {p : ℕ → Seminorm ℝ E} (hp : Monotone p) (loss : ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → ℝ) (hA : ∀ k, 0 ≤ A k) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ (z : E) (F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
      (q : PolarPoint → ℝ) (r : ℝ), RootEndpointTameJetBounds p loss A z F q r →
      1 ≤ B * (1 + p (N + loss) z) ∧
      (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → ∀ θ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (r, θ)‖ ≤ B * (1 + p (N + loss) z)) ∧
      (∀ k, k ≤ N → ∀ θ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q (r, θ)‖ ≤ B * (1 + p (N + loss) z)) ∧
      ∀ k, k ≤ N → ∀ θ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => (q y)⁻¹) (r, θ)‖ ≤ B * (1 + p (N + loss) z) := by
  let B : ℝ := 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), A k
  have hB : 1 ≤ B := le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hA k)
  have hAB (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) : A k ≤ B :=
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hA j)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega : k < N + 1))).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z F q r h
  have hone : 1 ≤ 1 + p (N + loss) z := le_add_of_nonneg_right (apply_nonneg _ _)
  have hraise (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
      A k * (1 + p (k + loss) z) ≤ B * (1 + p (N + loss) z) :=
    mul_le_mul (hAB k hk)
      (add_le_add le_rfl (hp (Nat.add_le_add_right hk loss) z))
      (add_nonneg zero_le_one (apply_nonneg _ _)) (zero_le_one.trans hB)
  exact ⟨hB.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right (zero_le_one.trans hB) hone),
    fun k hk hkn θ => (h.coordinate_jets k hk θ).trans (hraise k hkn),
    fun k hkn θ => (h.height_jets k θ).trans (hraise k hkn),
    fun k hkn θ => (h.inverse_height_jets k θ).trans (hraise k hkn)⟩

/-- One sequence of finite-prefix coefficients controls the genuine
source fields on one common neighborhood, for every high order. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actual_positiveSource_finite_prefixes
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) :
    ∃ newBase outLoss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ newBase ∧ outLoss ≤ newBase ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side,
      ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ N, 1 ≤ B N) ∧
        ∀ N z, z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C newBase ε' → stateSector S z.1 → ∀ side,
          let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
          let F := n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z
          let q := n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z
          let r := n04PositiveEndpoint i side
          let M := B N * (1 + pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading (N + outLoss)
            (z - (C.referenceState, 0)))
          1 ≤ M ∧
          (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → ∀ θ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F (r, θ)‖ ≤ M) ∧
          (∀ k, k ≤ N → ∀ θ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q (r, θ)‖ ≤ M) ∧
          ∀ k, k ≤ N → ∀ θ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => (q y)⁻¹) (r, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨newBase, outLoss, ε', hb, hl, hε', hε'ε, hsources⟩ :=
    n04Coordinates_actual_positiveSource_allJets hT hS hN hfield e
  have hp : Monotone (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading) :=
    tamePairGrading_monotone (stateGrading_monotone S) (fun _ _ _ => le_rfl)
  refine ⟨newBase, outLoss, ε', hb, hl, hε', hε'ε, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hsource⟩ := hsources i j
  choose B hB hbound using fun N => exists_rootEndpointTameJet_finite_prefix_envelope
    hp outLoss A (fun k => zero_le_one.trans (hA k)) N
  refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro N z hz hs side
  exact hbound N _ _ _ _ (hsource z hz hs side)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Ordinary finite regularity of the actual global relative fields

The existing radius selector glues the retained negative transport to
the constructed whole-positive transport. Its actual endpoint matching
gives one more derivative for the coordinate than for the height. The
same selected fields preserve the open annulus and the positive height.
No global regularity or matching conclusion is supplied as an input.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

/-- For the fixed construction order `n = 3`, both stored global fields
are C3. Increasing a requested estimate order never changes these fields. -/
theorem n04WholeCanonical_global_relative_regular
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (n : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    (τ σ : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (c d J H : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℝ)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    (hm : ∀ i,
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j i side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j i side) K z)
        (τ i) (σ i) (Q i) (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i)
        (c i) (d i) (J i) (H i)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    let F := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
    let q := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) F (annularOpen D) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ n q (annularOpen D) ∧
      MapsTo F (annularOpen D) (annularOpen D) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ annularOpen D, 0 < q p := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  have hmatch (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)) :
      WholePositiveNegativeRootJets n C K z i (τ i) (Q i) :=
    wholePositiveTransportMatching_negative_root_jets hN.1.1 (j i) (hm i)
  have hclosed (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint)
      (hp : p.1 ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) :
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) p ∧
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m) p ∧
        0 < canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m p :=
    canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_closed_regular hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m
      ⟨hp, mem_univ _⟩
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply n04WholeComponentField_contDiffOn (n + 1) hN.1.1
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
    · intro m p hp
      exact (hclosed m p hp).1.of_le (by simp)
    · intro i
      exact (hm i).geometry.smooth.of_le (by simp)
    · intro m side i hadj θ k hk
      exact (hmatch i m side hadj).1 θ k hk
  · apply n04WholeComponentField_contDiffOn n hN.1.1
      (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    · intro m p hp
      exact (hclosed m p hp).2.1.of_le (by simp)
    · intro i
      exact (hm i).height_smooth.of_le (by simp)
    · intro m side i hadj θ k hk
      exact (hmatch i m side hadj).2 θ k hk
  · exact n04WholeComponentField_mapsTo_annulus hN.1.1
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
      (fun m => canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_mapsTo_closed hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m)
      (fun i => (hm i).geometry.maps_open)
  · intro p hp
    have hD : RadialProfileGeometry D := (Classical.choose_spec hN.1.1.1.1).1
    have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
    have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) := hD.2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
    rcases n04_wholeComponent_cover hD hC hp.1 with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · rw [n04WholeComponentField_eq_negative hN.1.1
        (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) hm]
      exact (hclosed m p hm).2.2
    · rw [n04WholeComponentField_eq_positive hf hC
        (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) hi]
      exact (hm i).height_positive p

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Symmetries using only the selected component domains

The actual selector tests only the radius. Its chosen index comes with
membership in the corresponding closed negative or open positive piece.
Thus no symmetry of a stored endpoint field outside that piece is needed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set

theorem n04WholeComponentField_equivariant_on_components
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData} {C : NonlinearGeometryData S}
    {E : Type*} (Fneg : ℕ → PolarPoint → E)
    (Fpos : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → E)
    (fallback : PolarPoint → E) (σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Ψ : E → E)
    (hr : ∀ p, (σ p).1 = p.1)
    (hneg : ∀ m p, p.1 ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) →
      Fneg m (σ p) = Ψ (Fneg m p))
    (hpos : ∀ i p, p.1 ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) →
      Fpos i (σ p) = Ψ (Fpos i p))
    (hfb : ∀ p, fallback (σ p) = Ψ (fallback p)) (p : PolarPoint) :
    n04WholeComponentField C Fneg Fpos fallback (σ p) =
      Ψ (n04WholeComponentField C Fneg Fpos fallback p) := by
  classical
  simp only [n04WholeComponentField, hr p]
  split_ifs with hn hp
  · exact hneg (Classical.choose hn) p (Classical.choose_spec hn)
  · exact hpos (Classical.choose hp) p (Classical.choose_spec hp)
  · exact hfb p

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Physical symmetries of the same globally selected relative fields

The radius selector only evaluates a negative field on its own closed
component and a positive field on its open component. Thus their actual
symmetries on those sets suffice, without any condition on arbitrary
totalized negative values elsewhere. The fallback is the identity/one.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem n04WholeCanonical_global_relative_symmetries
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (n : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    (τ σ : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (c d J H : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℝ)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    (hm : ∀ i,
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j i side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j i side) K z)
        (τ i) (σ i) (Q i) (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i)
        (c i) (d i) (J i) (H i)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    let F := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
    let q := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    (∀ p, F (p + (0, Real.pi)) = F p + (0, Real.pi)) ∧
      Function.Periodic q (0, Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2)) ∧
      ∀ r θ, q (r, -θ) = q (r, θ) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  have hnegF (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint) (hp : p.1 ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) :=
    canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_symmetries_closed hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m
      (p := p) ⟨hp, mem_univ _⟩
  have hnegQ (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint) (hp : p.1 ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) :=
    canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio_symmetries_closed hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m
      (p := p) ⟨hp, mem_univ _⟩
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    exact n04WholeComponentField_equivariant_on_components
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
      (fun p => p + (0, Real.pi)) (fun p => p + (0, Real.pi))
      (fun p => by simp only [Prod.fst_add, add_zero])
      (fun m p hp => (hnegF m p hp).1)
      (fun i p _ => (hm i).geometry.period_add p) (fun _ => rfl) p
  · intro p
    exact n04WholeComponentField_equivariant_on_components
      (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      (fun p => p + (0, Real.pi)) id
      (fun p => by simp only [Prod.fst_add, add_zero])
      (fun m p hp => (hnegQ m p hp).1)
      (fun i p _ => by
        rcases p with ⟨r, θ⟩
        simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, id_eq] using (hm i).height_period r θ) (fun _ => rfl) p
  · intro p
    exact n04WholeComponentField_equivariant_on_components
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) τ id
      (fun p => (p.1, -p.2)) (fun p => (p.1, -p.2)) (fun _ => rfl)
      (fun m p hp => (hnegF m p hp).2)
      (fun i p _ => (hm i).geometry.reflect p) (fun _ => rfl) p
  · intro r θ
    exact n04WholeComponentField_equivariant_on_components
      (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) Q (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      (fun p => (p.1, -p.2)) id (fun _ => rfl)
      (fun m p hp => (hnegQ m p hp).2)
      (fun i p _ => (hm i).height_even p.1 p.2) (fun _ => rfl) (r, θ)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# The global relative fields on the reference pieces of the same atlas

The radius selector retains the whole-negative fields and the constructed
whole-positive fields. The genuine reference cut puts either negative
half inside its original component, where both stored charts give the
same actual travel transition and height ratio. On a positive piece the
reference identity and the actual inverse law identify the fields of the
same atlas record. No agreement conclusion is supplied as a hypothesis.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem n04WholeCanonical_global_relative_reference_agreement
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (σ τ : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    (c d J H : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℝ)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    (hm : ∀ i,
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j i side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j i side) K z)
        (τ z i) (σ z i) (Q z i) (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i)
        (c i) (d i) (J i) (H i))
    (href : ∀ i, σ (C.referenceState, 0) i = id ∧
      Q (C.referenceState, 0) i = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell σ τ Q N
    let F := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) (τ z) id
    let q := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) (Q z)
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    ∀ m, ∀ p ∈ referencePhysicalPieceOpen S W m,
      F p = canonicalCurrentPoint C W z m p ∧
        q p = W.height (C.referenceState, 0) m p / W.height z m (F p) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
  let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell σ τ Q N
  let F := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) (τ z) id
  let q := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) (Q z)
    (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  change ∀ m, ∀ p ∈ referencePhysicalPieceOpen S W m,
    F p = canonicalCurrentPoint C W z m p ∧
      q p = W.height (C.referenceState, 0) m p / W.height z m (F p)
  intro m p hp
  have hrad : W.physicalLeft m =
        n04WholePieceLeft C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) ∧
      W.physicalRight m =
        n04WholePieceRight C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) :=
    n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii
      hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell σ τ Q N m
  have hr : p.1 ∈ Ioo (n04WholePieceLeft C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m))
      (n04WholePieceRight C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m)) := by
    rw [← hrad.1, ← hrad.2]
    exact hp.1
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl a =>
      rcases a with ⟨a, side⟩
      have hhalf : p.1 ∈ Ioo (n04bNegativeLeft C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (a, side))
          (n04bNegativeRight C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (a, side)) := by
        simpa only [hi, n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight] using hr
      have hwhole : p ∈ Ioo (C.left a) (C.right a) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
        ⟨n04b_negativeHalf_subset (n04bActualReferenceCut_mem hN) (a, side) hhalf,
          mem_univ _⟩
      have hclosed : p.1 ∈ Icc (C.left a) (C.right a) :=
        ⟨hwhole.1.1.le, hwhole.1.2.le⟩
      let k := if side then (K.cutPair a).2 else (K.cutPair a).1
      have hk : e₀ k = .inl (a, side) := by
        have hpair : K.cutPair a =
            (e₀.symm (.inl (a, false)), e₀.symm (.inl (a, true))) := rfl
        dsimp only [k]
        rw [hpair]
        cases side <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      have hstored (v : AnnularState S × ℝ) :
          W.chart v m = K.chart v k ∧ W.inverseChart v m = K.inverseChart v k ∧
            W.height v m = K.height v k := by
        rcases n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_negative_fields
          C L K e cell σ τ Q N v m (a, side) hi with
          ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hchart, hinverse, hheight, _, _⟩
        exact ⟨hchart, hinverse, hheight⟩
      have hstoredPoint : canonicalCurrentPoint C W z m p =
          canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k p := by
        unfold canonicalCurrentPoint
        rw [(hstored z).2.1, (hstored (C.referenceState, 0)).1]
      have hFselected : F p = canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z a p :=
        n04WholeComponentField_eq_negative hN.1.1
          (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) (τ z) id (p := p) hclosed
      have hqselected : q p = canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z a p :=
        n04WholeComponentField_eq_negative hN.1.1
          (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) (Q z) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
          (p := p) hclosed
      have hcommon := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_eq_travel hT hS hN hfield e₀ hz hs a
      have hFtravel : F p = n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition S C L z a p :=
        hFselected.trans (hcommon.1 hwhole)
      have hqtravel : q p = n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelHeightRatio S C L z a p :=
        hqselected.trans (hcommon.2 hwhole)
      have hpoint : canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k p =
          n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition S C L z a p :=
        n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_currentPoint_eq_travel
          hT hS hN hfield hz hs a e₀ k side hk hwhole
      have hratio : K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k p /
          K.height z k (n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition S C L z a p) =
            n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelHeightRatio S C L z a p :=
        n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_height_ratio_eq_travel
          hT hS hN hfield hz hs a e₀ k side hk hwhole
      refine ⟨hFtravel.trans (hstoredPoint.trans hpoint).symm, ?_⟩
      calc
        q p = n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelHeightRatio S C L z a p := hqtravel
        _ = K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k p /
            K.height z k (n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition S C L z a p) := hratio.symm
        _ = W.height (C.referenceState, 0) m p / W.height z m (F p) := by
          rw [(hstored (C.referenceState, 0)).2.2, (hstored z).2.2, hFtravel]
  | inr i =>
      have hpositive : p.1 ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) := by
        simpa only [hi, n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight] using hr
      have hD := n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN
      have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) := hD.2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
      have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
      have hFselected : F p = τ z i p :=
        n04WholeComponentField_eq_positive hf hC
          (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) (τ z) id (p := p) hpositive
      have hqselected : q p = Q z i p :=
        n04WholeComponentField_eq_positive hf hC
          (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) (Q z) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
          (p := p) hpositive
      have hsame := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_positive_relative_fields
        C L K e cell σ τ Q N z m i hi (href i).1 (href i).2
        (hm i).geometry.left_inverse
      refine ⟨hFselected.trans (congrFun hsame.1 p).symm, ?_⟩
      calc
        q p = Q z i p := hqselected
        _ = n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C W z m p := (congrFun hsame.2 p).symm
        _ = W.height (C.referenceState, 0) m p / W.height z m (F p) := by
          unfold n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio
          rw [hsame.1, hFselected]

/-- The same fixed fields provide the qualitative transport clauses,
including agreement with every reference piece of the same atlas. The
quantitative material estimates are not inputs or conclusions here. -/
theorem n04WholeCanonical_global_relative_transport_qualitative
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (σ τ : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ)
    (j : ∀ i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w),
      ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    (c d J H : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℝ)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    (hm : ∀ i,
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
      WholePositiveTransportMatching 3
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j i side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j i side) K z)
        (τ z i) (σ z i) (Q z i) (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i)
        (c i) (d i) (J i) (H i))
    (href : ∀ i, σ (C.referenceState, 0) i = id ∧
      Q (C.referenceState, 0) i = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell σ τ Q N
    let F := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z) (τ z) id
    let q := n04WholeComponentField C (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z) (Q z)
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    ContDiffOn ℝ 3 F (annularOpen D) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 3 q (annularOpen D) ∧
      MapsTo F (annularOpen D) (annularOpen D) ∧
      (∀ p, F (p + (0, Real.pi)) = F p + (0, Real.pi)) ∧

name: Build

# Builds every library of the lakefile, runs the axiom audit (part of the default
# targets) and prints the axioms of the endpoint. A newer commit on the same ref
# cancels the running build.
#
# Runs once per pushed commit. Pull requests show the checks of their head commit,
# so there is no separate pull_request run; the lead verifies the merged result
# on an integration branch before pushing to main.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'line/**']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write # upload the precompiled build to the `lake-cache` release (main only)
  actions: write # replace this branch's previous build cache entry

concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "2"
      FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS: "300" # a changed file that compiles longer than this is stopped
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 400 # merge base with main; on main, the line heads merged by a push
      - name: Disk space
        # The runner has about 88 GB free; no cleanup is needed.
        run: df -h /
      - name: Set up the pinned Lean and Mathlib environment
        uses: leanprover/lean-action@fe408643ea7367d8c0404a8be3975bb145f5fb64
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "false"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          use-github-cache: "false"
      - name: Restore main's build artifacts
        # Layer 1, on every ref: the newest build of main. A line branch that merged
        # main reuses every module main has already compiled. (GitHub lets a branch
        # read only its own caches and main's, so main cannot reuse a line's cache.)
        id: restore-main
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: .lake/build
          key: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-main~${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-main~
      - name: Reuse the builds of the lines merged by this push
        # Caches are scoped per branch and main cannot read a line's cache, but it can
        # download another run's artifact. Each green line run uploads its build as
        # `lake-build-line`; for every `Merge line/X (sha)` commit not yet covered by
        # main's cache layer, oldest first, extract that line head's build on top.
        if: github.ref_name == 'main' || startsWith(github.ref_name, 'integrate/')
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MAIN_KEY: ${{ steps.restore-main.outputs.cache-matched-key }}
        run: |
          covered=${MAIN_KEY##*~}
          git log -30 --format='%H %P|%s' | grep '|Merge line/' | tac |
          while IFS='|' read -r shas subject; do
            set -- $shas
            commit=$1; head=${3:-}
            line=$(echo "$subject" | grep -o '^Merge line/[^ ]*' | sed 's/^Merge //')
            [ -n "$head" ] && [ -n "$line" ] || continue
            if [ -n "$covered" ] && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$commit" "$covered" 2>/dev/null; then
              continue
            fi
            id=$(gh run list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --branch "$line" --commit "$head" --status success               --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty' || true)
            if [ -z "$id" ]; then echo "$line @${head:0:8}: no green run"; continue; fi
            dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/line-build-$id"
            if gh run download "$id" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" -n lake-build-line -D "$dir"; then
              tar --zstd -xf "$dir/lake-build.tar.zst"
              echo "$line @${head:0:8}: reused the build of run $id"
            else
              echo "$line @${head:0:8}: run $id has no build artifact"
            fi
          done
      - name: Restore project build artifacts
        # Layer 2, on line branches only: this branch's own entry (one per branch;
        # the previous one is deleted when a new one is saved). Lake rebuilds any
        # module whose trace no longer matches, so the layering is safe. Without an
        # own entry the newest entry of any branch is used. `~` separates the branch
        # from the commit because git forbids it in branch names, so the prefix of
        # line/R10a does not match line/R10a-Inner.
        if: github.ref_name != 'main'
        id: restore
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: .lake/build
          key: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~
            lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-
      - name: Report which cache was restored
        run: |
          echo "main layer = ${{ steps.restore-main.outputs.cache-matched-key }}"
          echo "matched key = ${{ steps.restore.outputs.cache-matched-key }}"
      - name: Generate the root import
        run: python3 scripts/gen_root.py
      - name: Changed modules
        id: changed
        shell: bash
        run: |
          bash scripts/ci/changed_modules.sh > changed_modules.txt || true
          echo "count=$(wc -l < changed_modules.txt | tr -d ' ')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "$(wc -l < changed_modules.txt) changed modules"; head -40 changed_modules.txt
      - name: Quick check of the changed modules
        # Builds only the modules this branch changed (and what they import) and stops
        # the job on the first failure, so errors come back in minutes. A changed file
        # that compiles longer than FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS is stopped and reported.
        if: steps.changed.outputs.count != '0'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          bash scripts/ci/watchdog.sh changed_modules.txt "$FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS" &
          wd=$!
          set +e
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=60s 240m lake build -v $(cat changed_modules.txt) > quick.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          kill "$wd" 2>/dev/null
          grep -E '^(error|✖)' quick.log | head -100
          grep -E '^error' -A40 quick.log | head -400
          bash scripts/ci/slowest.sh quick.log
          if [ -s slow_files.txt ]; then
            while read -r m s; do
              echo "::error::$m compiled for more than $FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS seconds and was stopped; split the file or find the slow declaration"
            done < slow_files.txt
            status=1
          fi
          exit "$status"
      - name: Build every library
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          status=0
          bash scripts/ci/watchdog.sh changed_modules.txt "$FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS" &
          wd=$!
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=60s 270m lake build -v 2>&1 | tee build.log |
            awk '/^error:|^✖/ { remaining = 60 }
              /Build completed|Some required targets logged failures|error: build failed/ || remaining > 0 {
                print; fflush(); if (remaining > 0) remaining--
              }' || status=$?
          kill "$wd" 2>/dev/null || true
          grep -E '^(error|✖)' build.log | head -100 || true
          bash scripts/ci/slowest.sh build.log || true
          if [ -s slow_files.txt ]; then
            while read -r m s; do
              echo "::error::$m compiled for more than $FILE_LIMIT_SECONDS seconds and was stopped; split the file or find the slow declaration"
            done < slow_files.txt
            status=1
          fi
          exit "$status"
      - name: Save project build artifacts
        # Save first, delete older entries only after the save succeeded, so a cancelled
        # or failed run never leaves the branch without a cache.
        id: save
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: .lake/build
          key: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Delete this branch's older build caches
        if: always() && steps.save.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PREFIX: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~
          KEEP: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          gh cache list -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --key "$PREFIX" --limit 100 --json id,key             --jq '.[] | select(.key != $ENV.KEEP) | .id' |
            while read -r id; do gh cache delete "$id" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true; done
      - name: Count compiled modules
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          total=$(find src/ContinuousFlexibility -name '*.lean' | wc -l)
          built=$(find .lake/build/lib/lean/ContinuousFlexibility -name '*.olean' ! -name '*.server.olean' ! -name '*.private.olean' | wc -l)
          echo "modules compiled / total: $built / $total"
      - name: Blueprint status and endpoint axioms
        shell: bash
        run: lake env lean scripts/BlueprintStatus.lean
      - name: Publish the precompiled build for line sandboxes
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && success()
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          find .lake/build/ir -name '*.setup.json' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          tar --zstd -cf lake-build.tar.zst .lake/build
          ls -lh lake-build.tar.zst
          git rev-parse HEAD > lake-build.commit
          if gh release view lake-cache -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload lake-cache lake-build.tar.zst lake-build.commit --clobber -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          else
            echo "::warning::release lake-cache does not exist; the compiled build was not published"
          fi
      - name: Pack this line's build for main
        # Main downloads it (green runs only) when it merges this exact head; the build of a
        # failed run is kept too, so the lead can download it and compile files locally.
        if: startsWith(github.ref_name, 'line/') && !cancelled()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          find .lake/build/ir -name '*.setup.json' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          tar --zstd -cf lake-build.tar.zst .lake/build
          ls -lh lake-build.tar.zst
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: startsWith(github.ref_name, 'line/') && !cancelled()
        with:
          name: lake-build-line
          path: lake-build.tar.zst
          retention-days: 3
          compression-level: 0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: build-log
          path: |
            build.log
            quick.log

name: Probe

# Try several variants of one Lean file in parallel, one job per variant, on the
# branch that owns the file (so its build cache is readable). Each variant is a
# directory `probes/<name>/` on the probe branch whose contents are copied over the
# checkout, e.g. `probes/v1/src/ContinuousFlexibility/Analysis/Foo.lean`.
#   gh workflow run probe.yml --ref line/X -f probes=probe/X -f variants='["v1","v2"]' \
#     -f file=src/ContinuousFlexibility/Analysis/Foo.lean
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      probes:
        description: Branch that holds probes/<variant>/ directories
        required: true
      variants:
        description: JSON list of variant names
        required: true
      file:
        description: Lean file to check with `lake env lean`
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  probe:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        variant: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.variants) }}
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "4"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up the pinned Lean and Mathlib environment
        uses: leanprover/lean-action@fe408643ea7367d8c0404a8be3975bb145f5fb64
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "false"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          use-github-cache: "false"
      - name: Restore main's build
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: .lake/build
          key: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-main~${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-main~
      - name: Restore this branch's build
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: .lake/build
          key: lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            lake-build-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'lake-manifest.json') }}-${{ github.ref_name }}~
      - name: Apply variant ${{ matrix.variant }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch -q --depth=1 "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "${{ inputs.probes }}"
          git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- "probes/${{ matrix.variant }}"
          cp -r "probes/${{ matrix.variant }}/." .
          git status --short | head -20
      - name: Check ${{ inputs.file }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          start=$(date +%s)
          timeout 900 lake env lean "${{ inputs.file }}" 2>&1 | tee probe.log | grep -E '^[^ ]*error' -A25 | head -200
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "variant ${{ matrix.variant }}: exit $status after $(( $(date +%s) - start )) s"
          exit "$status"
